{
  "findings": [
    {
      "page": 272,
      "where": "Proof, diagram (*), upper-right vertex",
      "scan": "\\widehat{C'}_{\\underline{V}}",
      "tex": "C'\\widehat{\\phantom{a}}_{\\underline{V}}",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "\\widehat{C'}_{\\underline{U}}",
      "note": "The printed index V should be U: this is the target of u_{𝒰!}, before the vertical inclusion. The TeX keeps the misprint."
    },
    {
      "page": 272,
      "where": "Proof, immediately after the reference II 5.1 i)",
      "scan": "qu'un morphisme",
      "tex": "qu'on morphisme",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "qu'on morphisme",
        "new": "qu'un morphisme"
      },
      "note": "The print reads « qu'un », not « qu'on »."
    },
    {
      "page": 273,
      "where": "Proposition 1.6, condition ii)",
      "scan": "Pour tout famille couvrante",
      "tex": "Pour tout famille couvrante",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "Pour toute famille couvrante",
      "note": "The feminine agreement requires « toute ». The TeX keeps the printed typo."
    },
    {
      "page": 273,
      "where": "Footnote (*), « il suffit que ... commute »",
      "scan": "n",
      "tex": "$n$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "u",
      "note": "The functor is u, not n. The TeX keeps the printed letter."
    },
    {
      "page": 273,
      "where": "Footnote (*), final clause",
      "scan": "provenant de famille couvrantes pour T",
      "tex": "provenant de famille couvrantes pour $T$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "provenant de familles couvrantes pour $T$",
      "note": "The noun « famille » lacks its plural s. The TeX keeps the printed typo."
    },
    {
      "page": 274,
      "where": "First displayed diagram of sets, first term",
      "scan": "F(u(X)",
      "tex": "F(u(X)",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "F(u(X))",
      "note": "A closing parenthesis is missing. The TeX keeps the omission."
    },
    {
      "page": 274,
      "where": "First displayed diagram of sets, last term",
      "scan": "\\prod_{i,j}F(u(X_i\\times_X X_j)",
      "tex": "\\prod_{i,j}F(u(X_i\\times_X X_j)",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "\\prod_{i,j}F(u(X_i\\times_X X_j))",
      "note": "A closing parenthesis is missing here as well. The TeX keeps the omission."
    },
    {
      "page": 274,
      "where": "Second displayed diagram of sets, last factor",
      "scan": "X_i\\times_X X_j",
      "tex": "X_i\\times_X X_J",
      "kind": "formula",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "X_i\\times_X X_J",
        "new": "X_i\\times_X X_j"
      },
      "note": "The printed second index is lowercase j, consistent with the product indices i,j."
    },
    {
      "page": 274,
      "where": "Proposition 1.7, source and target of u_s^γ",
      "scan": "u^{\\gamma}_s:C^{\\sim}_{\\gamma}\\rightarrow {C'}^{\\sim}_{\\gamma}",
      "tex": "u^{\\gamma}_s:C^{\\sim}_{\\gamma}\\rightarrow\n{C'}^{\\sim}_{\\gamma}",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "u^{\\gamma}_s:{C'}^{\\sim}_{\\gamma}\\rightarrow C^{\\sim}_{\\gamma}",
      "note": "The printed source and target are reversed: u_s, and hence u_s^γ, goes from sheaves on C' to sheaves on C. The TeX keeps the misprint."
    },
    {
      "page": 275,
      "where": "Proposition 1.7, item 2), right-hand side of the isomorphism",
      "scan": "\\underline{a}'_{\\gamma}u'_{\\gamma!}",
      "tex": "\\underline{a}'_{\\gamma} u'_{\\gamma !}",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "\\underline{a}'_{\\gamma} u_{\\gamma !}",
      "note": "The prime on u is extraneous; the functor is u_{γ!}, as in item 1). The TeX keeps the printed prime."
    },
    {
      "page": 275,
      "where": "Item 4), upper horizontal arrow of the diagram",
      "scan": "u_{\\gamma}^{s}",
      "tex": "u_{Y}^{s}",
      "kind": "symbol",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "u_{Y}^{s}",
        "new": "u_{\\gamma}^{s}"
      },
      "note": "The printed subscript is γ, as in the vertices and the surrounding formulas, not Latin Y."
    },
    {
      "page": 275,
      "where": "Item 5), parenthetical second forgetful functor",
      "scan": "(resp. ${\\esj'}^{\\sim}$)",
      "tex": "(\\resp $\\esj^{\\sim}$)",
      "kind": "symbol",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "(\\resp $\\esj^{\\sim}$)",
        "new": "(\\resp ${\\esj'}^{\\sim}$)"
      },
      "note": "The print has a prime on the second esj."
    },
    {
      "page": 275,
      "where": "Final paragraph of the proposition, « l'adjoint à gauche de u_s »",
      "scan": "u_s",
      "tex": "$u_s$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "medium",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "u^{\\gamma}_s",
      "note": "The γ superscript is omitted in print and in the TeX. The adjoints under discussion are those of u_s^γ on γ-objects, as specified in the preceding sentence."
    },
    {
      "page": 275,
      "where": "Diagram (1.7.1), lower horizontal arrow",
      "scan": "u^s_{r\\underline{V}}",
      "tex": "u^s_{r\\underline{V}}",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "u^s_{\\gamma\\underline{V}}",
      "note": "The printed Latin r should be γ. The TeX keeps the wrong letter."
    }
  ],
  "coordinator": "271: 0/0; 272: 1/1; 273: 0/3; 274: 1/3; 275: 2/3 (normal/misprint)."
}
